steps.title: Source and Sink Connectors
steps.text: Data integration moves data in and out of Surgewave. Source connectors ingest external data into topics, while sink connectors export topic data to external systems.

steps.title: Source vs Sink
steps.text: Sources read from external systems like files and databases into Surgewave topics. Sinks write from Surgewave topics out to databases, files, and other destinations.

steps.title: Connector Modes
steps.text: Choose between bulk mode for one-time full loads, incremental mode for ongoing synchronization, and CDC mode for capturing every database change in real-time.

steps.title: Key Concepts
steps.text: Lesson 8.2 covers file connectors for CSV and JSON, Lesson 8.3 covers database connectors, and Lesson 8.4 dives into Change Data Capture patterns.

steps.title: Building Custom Connectors
steps.text: Lesson 8.5 teaches you to build your own connectors for any data source or sink, extending Surgewave's integration capabilities to fit your specific needs.
